Subject: Renewal & Capacity Expansion — Stakeholder sync and timeline

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. Per our notes, Globex's current contract (RWD-7421) is up for renewal on 2026-09-30 and you're planning to increase committed capacity by ~2x to support the new recommendation engine launch in Q1. I want to start a short renewal kickoff so we can align stakeholders, confirm procurement timing, and lock a QBR date.

Proposed high-level timeline:
- Week of Jul 26: Stakeholder alignment call (procurement + engineering + product)
- Week of Aug 9: Finalize mutual action plan / pricing and sign SOW/DocuSign
- Week of Sep 20: Renewal effective date prep + QBR (goal: week prior to contract end)

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm who will own procurement and who will be the technical throughput contact (we've tentatively listed Tom for infra).
2) Does the target of a 2x committed GPU pool and 24-month term still sound right, or would you prefer to discuss a 12-month with a higher short-term commit?
3) Which two dates work best for the stakeholder alignment call next week — Tue 7/27 or Thu 7/29 (30–45m)?

I've attached a starter mutual_action_plan_globex_v1.xlsx that lays out milestones and ownerships. Aditya (cc) will follow up with a pricing options PDF and a first-pass SOW. Rachel will coordinate the QBR agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Quick answers up front:
- Procurement lead: procurement@globex.com (please include them on any SOW/contract threads).
- Technical lead: Tom Nguyen (cc'd) will own throughput & integration.
- Term preference: We're leaning to 24 months if pricing is favorable, but we'd like the option for a 12-month pilot with a fast path to expand commit after 90 days.

We can do the stakeholder alignment call on Thu 7/29 10:00–10:45 PT. If you can send calendar invite and a short agenda, we'll accept.

Also: could you include a couple options for committed capacity (2x and 3x) and the associated unit pricing? We need that to model budget impact in this quarter.

Appreciate the attachments — procurement wants the mutual action plan and a redline-friendly SOW.

Thanks Sarah — glad that works. Attached is a short pricing options pack (redwood_pricing_v2.pdf) with three flavors:

Option A — 12-month term, 3x committed pool (intro pricing)
- Ideal if you want aggressive headroom for launch. Lower provisioning lead time but higher committed spend.
Option B — 24-month term, 2x committed pool (recommended)
- Better unit economics, lower price per token, and a longer commit to stabilize costs.
Option C — 12-month hybrid: Start at 2x committed with an automatic scale-to-3x after 90 days conditioned on usage thresholds.

Discounting note: We can offer a stepped discount tied to total committed GPU hours; Marcus will put numbers in the call slides. We can also include a one-time migration credit to offset any switching costs.

SOW note: I'll attach a first-pass SOW in the follow-up email today (renewal_sow_globex.docx). For procurement, we are happy to accept standard Globex contract language but expect typical Redwood clauses around data handling and SLAs.

I will also add 7/29 10:00 PT to my calendar. Kimberly — can you send the invite with the attached MAP and the short agenda?

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
